product_intent.desired_outcome: To provide a unified internal dashboard that synchronizes warehouse queues with driver assignments to eliminate shipment bottlenecks, improve operational efficiency, and ensure accurate record-keeping.
product_intent.name: Harbor Dispatch Desk Internal Tool
product_intent.problem: The current process for managing dispatch, assigning drivers, and keeping shipment records is inefficient and prone to errors, leading to bottlenecks and potential delays in logistics operations.
product_intent.summary: A staff-only internal tool for the warehouse team to manage the dispatch queue, assign drivers, and maintain shipment records.

requirements.description: The system must analyze shipment deadlines and driver locations to suggest which loads should be moved first.
requirements.title: Smart Queue Prioritization

requirements.description: The system must automatically extract shipment IDs and destination data from uploaded paper manifests or photos.
requirements.title: OCR Document Scanner

requirements.description: The system must monitor average loading times and flag when the warehouse is falling behind schedule.
requirements.title: Bottleneck Predictor

requirements.description: The system must suggest the most efficient sequence for drivers handling multiple drops.
requirements.title: Auto-Route Optimization

requirements.description: The product must be a staff-only internal tool for the warehouse team, not a public website.
requirements.title: Staff-Only Internal Tool

requirements.description: The system must allow the warehouse team to work the dispatch queue.
requirements.title: Manage Dispatch Queue

requirements.description: The system must enable the warehouse team to assign drivers to shipments.
requirements.title: Assign Drivers

requirements.description: The system must maintain accurate and accessible shipment records.
requirements.title: Keep Shipment Records
